results.evidence: The first ascensionist's account says the redpoint began at 11:20 AM and pitch 11 was finished almost exactly 11 hours after starting to climb, so 11 hrs is time on route, not car-to-car; this makes timing.totalHrs 11.5, the itinerary hours, the totalNote and hazards[1]'s '~11 hours car-to-car' too short. The first-ascent report in the alpine journal gives no hours, and no second source gives a car-to-car figure. Would settle with: any repeat party's car-to-car time.

results.correct_value: One repeat, by Alex Honnold (single source)
results.evidence: A climbing-magazine feature on Dark Side of Liberty states that A Slave to Liberty (5.13-, 11 pitches, Schaefer 2016) 'has had only one repeat—by Alex Honnold', which supports crowds and contradicts hazards[1] and requiredSkills[2]. The route page, the first-ascent report and the Dark Side report do not mention it, and the forum thread on Honnold at Washington Pass could not be read. Only one source. Would settle with: a second independent account of Honnold's repeat.

results.fact: Parking pass at the hairpin pullout
results.evidence: The Liberty Bell area page and a Washington Pass climbing overview both require a Northwest Forest Pass explicitly only at the Blue Lake Trailhead and describe the east-side hairpin parking without mentioning a pass. Neither says in so many words that no pass is needed at the hairpin, and no Forest Service page lists or excludes the pullout. Would settle with: an Okanogan-Wenatchee NF fee-site list, or two sources saying explicitly that the hairpin pullout needs no pass.

results.fact: Gain and distance in the header
results.evidence: The route and Liberty Crack pages describe the east-side approach from the hairpin pond, and a trip report gives about an hour, but none states a mileage or a car-to-car gain; the Blue Lake-based itinerary (5 mi, 2,400 ft) and loss_ft cannot be replaced from a stated figure. Cascadeclimbers trip reports for this route could not be read (blocked). Would settle with: two trip reports stating hairpin-to-East-Face distance and total gain.

No source found giving a car-to-car time for Thin Red Line; the route page gives none, and the readable trip report gives only the approach time. The forum trip reports were blocked. Would settle with: two party reports of car-to-car time.

Both the first-ascent report and a magazine feature say the first ascent got a late start and topped out as it got dark, with no hours stated. No car-to-car figure exists, so neither 12 hrs nor the 15-16 hr schedule can be confirmed. Would settle with: any repeat party's timing.

results.evidence: Sources give the traverse's climbing length (~2,000 ft / 606 m) and the Blue Lake approach (about 2,000 ft to the notch, 5 mi round trip for Liberty Bell alone), but no source states a car-to-car total gain for the five-summit traverse. The rules forbid computing one. Would settle with: two traverse trip reports stating total gain.

results.correct_value: ~2.5 mi one way (5 mi round trip), tentatively
results.evidence: Two independent sources give 5 miles round trip from the Blue Lake Trailhead to Liberty Bell (a guide page; a GPS trip report that went to the summit), which fits the itinerary's 5.2 mi. A third gives 4 miles round trip and an earlier one about 6.3, so every source puts the one-way distance at or below ~3.15 mi, under the summit pin's 3.34 mi (dist_km 5.46). But the stored value is the same quantity measured differently, not a different quantity, so the dist_km rule does not allow a change. Would settle with: an owner decision to adopt 2.5 mi one way, or a measured track to the west-face base.
